mapper.sql: scope_key, logical_path, rule_enabled, sort_field, sort_order, head_count, tail_count, fill_policy
( scope_key, logical_path, rule_enabled, sort_field, sort_order, head_count, tail_count, fill_policy )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workplace_dir_rule VALUES ( #{scopeKey}, #{logicalPath}, #{ruleEnabled}, #{sortField}, #{sortOrder}, #{headCount}, #{tailCount}, #{fillPolicy} ) ON CONFLICT(scope_key, logical_path) DO UPDATE SET rule_enabled = excluded.rule_enabled, sort_field = excluded.sort_field, sort_order = excluded.sort_order, head_count = excluded.head_count, tail_count = excluded.tail_count, fill_policy = excluded.fill_policy

INSERT INTO workplace_dir_rule VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT(scope_key, logical_path) DO UPDATE SET rule_enabled = excluded.rule_enabled, sort_field = excluded.sort_field, sort_order = excluded.sort_order, head_count = excluded.head_count, tail_count = excluded.tail_count, fill_policy = excluded.fill_policy
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM workplace_dir_rule WHERE scope_key = #{scopeKey} AND (logical_path = #{path} OR logical_path LIKE #{childPattern} ESCAPE '\\')
mapper.update: UPDATE workplace_dir_rule SET logical_path = CASE WHEN logical_path = #{oldBase} THEN #{newBase} ELSE #{newBase} || substr(logical_path, length(#{oldBase}) + 1) END WHERE scope_key = #{scopeKey} AND (logical_path = #{oldBase} OR logical_path LIKE #{childPattern} ESCAPE '\\')
